openingTransmission: Our Shaykh, the Imam, the most eminent, the unique, the Ḥāfiẓ, Tāj al-Dīn, Bahāʾ al-Islām, Badīʿ al-Zamān, Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muḥammad ibn Masʿūd al-Bandahī, may God grant him success and give him insight into his own faults, narrated to us, by his reading to us from the original of his hearing, from which it was copied, in the Nāṣiriyya Ṣalāḥiyya school (may God perpetuate the dominion of its endower), on the 26th of Dhū al-Qaʿda in the year 577 AH. He said: The trustworthy, righteous Shaykh Abū al-Khayr Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿUmar al-Muqaddar al-Aṣbahānī informed us, by reading to him while I listened. He said: Shaykh Abū ʿAmr ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh ibn Isḥāq ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Mandah al-Aṣbahānī informed us. He said: My father, the Imam Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq, informed us. He said: Abū Bakr Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn al-Khalīl al-Qaṭṭān informed us. He said: Abū al-Ḥasan Aḥmad ibn Yūsuf al-Sulamī narrated to us. He said: ʿAbd al-Razzāq ibn Hammām ibn Nāfiʿ al-Ḥimyarī narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Hammām ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abū Hurayra narrated to us from Muḥammad, the Messenger of God.

firstReport.en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "We are the last, yet the foremost on the Day of Resurrection, although they were given the Book before us, and we were given it after them. This is their day, which was made obligatory upon them, but they differed about it, and God guided us to it. So they follow us in it: the Jews tomorrow, and the Christians the day after tomorrow."
firstReport.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، بَيْدَ أَنَّهُمْ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا فَاخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ، وَأُوتِينَاهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ، فَهَذَا يَوْمُهُمُ الَّذِي فُرِضَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَاخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ، فَهَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَهُ، فَهُمْ لَنَا فِيهِ تَبَعٌ فَالْيَهُودُ غَدًا وَالنَّصَارَى بَعْدَ غَدٍ»
